name: Worst Mistakes / Partial Equivalence Queries Complexity
details: For finite concept classes, $\mathrm{M}_{\mathrm{worst}}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{par}}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: Corollary 8(1) of Doliwa--Fan--Simon--Zilles states $\mathrm{LC}_{\mathrm{partial}}(\mathcal H)\leq\mathrm{Mopt}(\mathcal H)$.  Their $\mathrm{Mopt}$ is the optimal adversarial online mistake bound, which is precisely the catalogue's $\mathrm{M}_{\mathrm{worst}}$, while $\mathrm{LC}_{\mathrm{partial}}$ is its partial-equivalence-query complexity.
